verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs say structured extraction returns specific fields "with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability." Extraction is schema-driven via the /extract API, so the core of field-level provenance is documented. The support rests on a single overview line, though. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-field page numbers and source text snippets, a response-format reference showing the citation structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration that citations work as claimed.
